about_the_game:
This content requires the base game Lost Skies on Steam in order to play. This DLC is an exclusive to Worlds Adrift players and will be inaccessible unless Worlds Adrift is in also in their library.

To celebrate the legacy of Worlds Adrift that inspired Lost Skies, we're releasing an exclusive DLC for all players who have Worlds Adrift in their Steam library. Soar into the skies with the familiar (and glowed up!) items from your previous adventures:

  • Mask of Pale Fox

  • Time Lost Grappling Hook

  • Schematic: Founder's Plaque (craftable ship part)

  • Schematic: Founder's Flag (craftable ship part)

  • Schematic: Founder's Helm (craftable ship part)

We know how much Worlds Adrift meant to you, and we're really grateful for your continuous support and passion for this universe. See you in the skies!
